source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U14: Prepare jurisdiction, pleadings, affidavits and related-party recovery applications

facts.statement: Section19 jurisdiction alternatives,other-bank joinder beforefinalorder,prescribed evidence/fees;transferred suit fee distinction. Summons30days,exceptional additional15 for defence;verified pleadings/affidavits;setoff/counterclaim have cross-suit function.

payload.title: A filing package connects the remedy to admissible facts
payload.core_explanation_md:
Select a section19 forum using the applicable account-office, defendant or cause-of-action jurisdiction facts. The package needs the prescribed form, fee and evidence; a statutory transfer from a civil court has a different fee position from a fresh application. Another qualifying lender claim against the same defendant can use the stated joinder route before final order.

The defence, set-off and counterclaim also require proper pleadings and verification. The source describes thirty days after service for the written statement with only a qualified additional fifteen days in exceptional circumstances. A potential extension is not one already granted. Unsupported facts cannot be turned into evidence simply by including them in an unverified pleading.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an expected extension automatically change the response deadline?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The applicable order and statutory conditions must be established.

payload.stem_md: A defendant plans to rely on a qualified extension but has no order granting one. What should the response calendar show?

options.text_md: The latest possible date as automatically granted
options.explanation_md: Possibility and actual grant are distinct.

options.text_md: No deadline until the next hearing
options.explanation_md: The source links the initial period to service.

options.text_md: Only the date the bank opened the account
options.explanation_md: That is not the summons-response trigger.

options.text_md: The operative response deadline, with any extension tracked separately
options.explanation_md: The calendar should reflect actual authority, not expectation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The calendar should reflect actual authority, not expectation.

payload.stem_md: A counterclaim is supported only by unverified assertions despite the applicable affidavit requirement. What is the evidential issue?

options.explanation_md: The verification framework applies to the stated pleadings.

options.text_md: The facts must satisfy the prescribed verification/evidence requirements
options.explanation_md: Inclusion in a pleading alone does not establish admissible support.

options.text_md: The counterclaim necessarily pays off every bank claim
options.explanation_md: A pleaded claim is not an adjudicated set-off or payment.

options.text_md: The bank can delete the counterclaim from the court record privately
options.explanation_md: The issue belongs to the Tribunal process.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Inclusion in a pleading alone does not establish admissible support.
